info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Reversal API
info.description: The Payment Reversal API facilitates the process of reversing a payment transaction identified by its unique payment ID. This endpoint allows businesses to manage payment disputes or errors by initiating a reversal request, ensuring proper transaction handling and financial accuracy. Typically utilized by financial institutions and payment processing systems, it helps streamline operations in cases of refunds, canceled transactions, or other adjustments. Users can expect timely feedback on the reversal status to inform further actions in their payment workflows.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to reverse a specific payment transaction identified by its unique ID. It is important to ensure that the payment is eligible for reversal based on your business rules before invoking this action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to reverse a payment with the ID PAY-300045. It must contain the required information to process the reversal securely and accurately.

200.description: The reversal request was processed successfully, and the payment has been reversed.
